descriptions.w3d_f11a_setup_selection_80286100: Build highlight and grey resource names from the context format, resolve them through the base subobject at28 with the observed mode-dependent byte layer, attach successful interfaces to the host and context, and hide those variants. For a nonzero colour code, format the corresponding Blue/Green/Blue/Purple/Red suffix or fallback, resolve the normal resource, and attach it; failed highlight or normal resolution writes the observed error text. Always refresh interfaces and finish the local shared string. Roles and type names inferred; owner/context/interface views are partial, and all external data remains unowned.
